What we offer

Objective: Turn interest into commitments

Your objectives

  • Find the right opportunities
  • Enter and grow in Japan or India
  • Turn interest into commitments
  • Set up and improve operations
  • Create new business and sustain value
  • Coordinate complex initiatives

View all services

← Back to all services

Objective

Turn interest into commitments

Develop workable agreements, qualify suppliers and prepare opportunities for financing with qualified specialists.

Services for this objective

Select an offering to see what it involves.

  • Develop workable agreements

    Help the parties agree on commercial responsibilities, expectations and terms—including how a pilot or trial would lead to a further decision.

    4 offerings

    • Collaboration design
      What we do
      Develop options for contributions, rights, decisions and commercial arrangements.
      What you receive
      A proposed collaboration structure.
      Why this matters
      Give the parties a shared basis for negotiation.

      Discuss this offering

    • Pilot-to-decision planning

      Give the trial a clear purpose—and a decision to inform.

      What we do
      Help the parties establish what the pilot must demonstrate, how it will be funded, when it will be reviewed and what commitment could follow.
      What you receive
      A proposed pilot framework covering acceptance criteria, responsibilities, funding, timing and next steps.
      Why this matters
      A trial designed to support a decision, rather than continuing without a clear conclusion.

      The parties retain their own approval and purchasing decisions.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

      Discuss this offering

    • Negotiation support
      What we do
      Prepare positions and support discussions between the parties.
      What you receive
      Documented options and agreed terms if negotiations conclude.
      Why this matters
      Address misunderstandings before signing.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Concluding international licensing and manufacturing agreements
      • Concluding technology partnerships with Israeli and Korean companies
      • Negotiating an ownership transition for a software business

      Discuss this offering

    • Agreement preparation
      What we do
      Translate agreed commercial terms into a term sheet.
      What you receive
      A term sheet for the parties’ lawyers.
      Why this matters
      Give legal drafting a clear commercial foundation.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Qualify and develop suppliers

    Find and assess suppliers against buyer requirements, coordinate qualification and identify improvements needed to become a suitable supplier.

    4 offerings

    • Supplier requirements brief
      What we do
      Translate technical, quality and commercial requirements into actionable expectations.
      What you receive
      A clear supplier requirements brief.
      Why this matters
      Help suppliers understand what they must demonstrate.

      Discuss this offering

    • Supplier search and readiness assessment
      What we do
      Identify candidates and assess capabilities, capacity and gaps.
      What you receive
      A readiness assessment for each candidate.
      Why this matters
      Build a realistic shortlist.

      Directly related experience

      Our team’s individual experience

      • Opening markets for industrial manufacturers

      Discuss this offering

    • Qualification and trial coordination
      What we do
      Coordinate samples, audits, tests and approval steps.
      What you receive
      A qualification plan and record, including the buyer’s decision.
      Why this matters
      Keep the qualification process moving between the parties.

      Discuss this offering

    • Supplier development plan
      What we do
      Agree on improvements and track them, involving technical experts where needed.
      What you receive
      An improvement plan and progress reports.
      Why this matters
      Support progress towards the buyer’s requirements.

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

  • Prepare opportunities for financing

    Develop the investment case, consider staged commitments and connect with relevant financial partners, working with qualified specialists where required.

    4 offerings

    • Funding needs and staging
      What we do
      Assess funding needs, timing and what each stage must demonstrate.
      What you receive
      A staged funding plan.
      Why this matters
      Match investment commitments to evidence.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japan–India venture preparing to approach financiers

      Discuss this offering

    • Risk-sharing options
      What we do
      Explore how participants, customers and financiers could share costs and risks.
      What you receive
      Options for discussion.
      Why this matters
      Consider opportunities that one party may struggle to carry alone.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japan–India venture preparing to approach financiers

      Discuss this offering

    • Investment case preparation
      What we do
      Develop the commercial case for prospective financiers and partners.
      What you receive
      A documented investment case.
      Why this matters
      Prepare for substantive financing discussions.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japan–India venture preparing to approach financiers

      Discuss this offering

    • Financing partner introductions
      What we do
      Coordinate relevant introductions through authorized specialists.
      What you receive
      Introductions and supported discussions.
      Why this matters
      Explore suitable funding routes; financiers decide whether to fund.

      Directly related experience

      Illustrative scenarios (hypothetical)

      • A Japan–India venture preparing to approach financiers

      Discuss this offering

    Discuss this service

You can start with one focused piece of work. Getting started

Each assignment includes the offerings agreed with you. Recommendations support your decisions; customers, partners and financiers make their own decisions.
